item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:05 HKT 17/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with one or two showers over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The northeast monsoon will moderate slightly during the weekend. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China on Sunday. The weather will be slightly cooler over the region early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, a board trough of low pressure will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China. Besides, the Tropical Cyclone over the central part of the South China Sea will move in the general direction of the vicinity of Hainan Island and the central to northern parts of Vietnam today and tomorrow. Tropical Cyclone Pulasan will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move inland over eastern China and dissipate gradually today.
